newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian govt banks to work full day on March 29.
newsitem.headline: Indian govt banks to work full day on March 29.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Thursday it advised all public sector banks that their branches conducting government business should be open for the full day on Saturday, March 29, 1997.
These banks would accept deposits towards government duties and taxes, RBI said in a statement on Thursday.
"This is done in the public interest and to obviate the inconvenience likely to be caused to assessees on account of March 28, 1997, being a holiday and March 30 being a Sunday," it said.
